news.geopolitics_summary: Iran–US escalation risks Hormuz transit; EU nuclear output threatened by climate stress; data-center demand surge pressures power grids.

themes.headline: Europe's nuclear fleet threatened by rising temperatures and cooling water scarcity
themes.why_it_matters: Nuclear outages due to thermal stress reduce baseload supply, tightening EU power curve. High-temperature summers already force reactor shutdowns; accelerates need for fossil/renewables substitution. Direct Cal+1 upside risk.

themes.headline: US LNG exports surge 23% in H1 2026 to 17.4 Bcf/d capacity growth
themes.why_it_matters: Higher US LNG output increases NW Europe LNG arb supply, exerting downward pressure on TTF via substitution. Larger global LNG volume eases EU gas tightness, supports power-curve weakness via lower gas-to-power.

themes.headline: US–Iran military escalation risks Strait of Hormuz oil and LNG transit
themes.why_it_matters: Hormuz closure scenario would disrupt ~20% of seaborne oil and LNG flows. EU LNG supply shock → TTF spike → power curve bullish. Risk premium already building; further strikes increase tail-risk premium on front-month contracts.

themes.headline: EU green-transition chief explores oil tax, joint debt to fund climate resilience
themes.why_it_matters: Potential new EU carbon/energy tax mechanisms could raise operating costs for coal/gas generators and increase power-curve volatility via regulatory capex burden. Signals climate-driven policy intensification; monitor EUA structural bid upside.

themes.headline: Power-hungry data centers expanding across Europe, sparking environmental resistance
themes.why_it_matters: Explosive AI/data-center load growth (especially Google EU capex) adds structural baseload demand to regional grids. Exacerbates summer cooling constraints on nuclear; increases peak-hour power demand and DA spread volatility. Multi-year bullish power curve dynamic.

watchlist: Von der Leyen State of the Union speech — climate/AI/green capex agenda may signal new carbon-pricing or emissions-abatement rules.
EU industrial policy / Industrial Accelerator Act votes — could reshape grid infrastructure spend and renewables/nuclear procurement timelines.
Hormuz tensions escalation watch — track US–Iran military activity daily for LNG flow disruption risk and TTF premium.
EU budget negotiation outcome — Costa's call for new taxes may influence green capex financing, EUA scarcity expectations.
